config.name: reclaim.interval
config.description: reclaim image store interval in seconds, 0 means disabled

config.name: zstore.allow.ports
config.description: tcp or udp ports allowed by zstore, udp port start with 'u' like 'u67', port range can be like this: 1100:1200, multiple port or port range can be separated by ”,“

config.name: blob.upload.concurrency
config.description: concurrency when upload blobs of single image to imagestore

config.name: blob.download.concurrency
config.description: concurrency when download blobs of single image from imagestore
